facts.fact: According to Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video report (third-party), 89% of consumers say they want to see more video from brands.
facts.quote: According to Wyzowl's 2024 State of Video report, 89% of consumers say they want to see more video from brands.

facts.fact: Wavemaker (vendor) outputs 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 natively, plus 2:3 via the API.
facts.quote: Wavemaker outputs 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, and 4:5 natively (plus 2:3 via the API)

facts.fact: Per the vendor, each Wavemaker edit or refine costs about 15 credits.
facts.quote: Each edit or refine costs about 15 credits

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan starts users with 75 credits, at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: On the free plan you start with 75 credits, enough for your first video, at 480p with a watermark.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, a roughly 30-second Wavemaker video costs about 75 credits.
facts.quote: A roughly 30-second video runs about 75 credits and a 60-second one about 150

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Starter plan costs $29 per month for 500 credits, with output up to 1080p and no watermark.
facts.quote: Starter is $29/mo for 500 credits and up to 1080p with no watermark

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Pro plan costs $99 per month for 2,000 credits, including API and MCP access and custom voice design.
facts.quote: Pro is $99/mo for 2,000 credits with API and MCP access and custom voice design

facts.fact: Wavemaker's Business plan costs $299 per month for 8,000 credits, with output up to 4K.
facts.quote: Business is $299/mo for 8,000 credits and up to 4K

facts.fact: Wavemaker credit packs start at $9.99 for 100 credits, and per the vendor the credits never expire.
facts.quote: Credit packs start at $9.99 for 100 and, unlike some tools, never expire.

facts.fact: Adwave says a finished Wavemaker video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks, starting from $50.
facts.quote: a finished Wavemaker video can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50

facts.fact: Adwave says it can put a video on streaming TV from $30 a day.
facts.quote: Adwave can put it on streaming TV from $30 a day.

facts.fact: Adwave says each chat edit in Wavemaker costs about 15 credits.
facts.quote: Because chat edits cost only about 15 credits each, the volume stays affordable.

facts.fact: Adwave says new users can create their first video free with 75 credits.
facts.quote: Create your first video free with 75 credits and see how far one idea can travel.

facts.fact: Adwave says most videos take two to five minutes to generate in Wavemaker.
facts.quote: Most videos take two to five minutes to generate, so you can build a week of content in a single sitting.

facts.fact: Adwave states that a single 10-minute video typically holds three to five clip-worthy moments.
facts.quote: A single 10-minute video typically holds three to five clip-worthy moments

facts.fact: Adwave claims one source can easily produce six or more native posts when combined with a square summary, a teaser, and a longer explainer.
facts.quote: one source easily produces six or more native posts.
